# Third-party marks

Logos of the model providers listed in the hub README. Each file is kept as downloaded; the generator turns them into the black tiles in [../icons/](../icons/) (`logo-*.png`), rendering monochrome marks in white, without redrawing them. They identify the companies and products they belong to and remain the property of their owners; they are not Crusoe brand assets and are not covered by the repository license.

| <div align="center">File</div> | <div align="center">Mark</div> | <div align="center">Source</div> | <div align="center">Notes</div> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [deepseek.svg](deepseek.svg) | DeepSeek | [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons) (`deepseek`), CC0 | Monochrome |
| [google.svg](google.svg) | Google | Simple Icons (`google`), CC0 | Monochrome |
| [meta.svg](meta.svg) | Meta | Simple Icons (`meta`), CC0 | Monochrome |
| [moonshot-kimi.svg](moonshot-kimi.svg) | Moonshot AI (Kimi) | Simple Icons (`kimi`), CC0 | Monochrome |
| [nvidia.svg](nvidia.svg) | NVIDIA | Simple Icons (`nvidia`), CC0 | Monochrome |
| [openai.svg](openai.svg) | OpenAI | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ChatGPT_logo.svg) | Background plate removed and blossom rendered in white at tile time |
| [qwen.svg](qwen.svg) | Qwen (Alibaba) | Simple Icons (`qwen`), CC0 | Monochrome |
| [zai.png](zai.png) | Z.ai | Mark as used on [crusoe.ai/cloud/managed-inference](https://www.crusoe.ai/cloud/managed-inference) | Raster, kept as is |

Simple Icons redraws official marks as single-path SVGs and releases them under CC0; the underlying trademarks stay with their owners. Replace a file here with an official download if brand guidance changes, and rerun the generator.
